# neon_org_member_role (Resource)

Manages permissions of an organization's member.

	Note that the deletion will only delete the resource from the tf state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "neon_org_member_role" "example" {
  org_id    = "org-foo-bar-28866559"
  member_id = "28012f1d-fe85-4d69-be44-79f561ce10f6"
  role      = "editor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_id` (String) The organization member ID.
- `org_id` (String) The organisation ID.
- `role` (String) The member's explicit organization role: `viewer`, `editor`, `admin`, or `collaborator`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The org. member role ID.



## Import

The Neon organization role can be imported to the terraform state by its composite identifier that consists of
`OrgID` and `MemberID` separated by a forward slash.

Import using the [import block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import):

For example:

```hcl
import {
  to = neon_org_member_role.example
  id = "org-restless-silence-28866559/28012f1d-fe85-4d69-be44-79f561ce10f6"
}
```

Import using the command `terraform import`:

```commandline
terraform import neon_org_member_role.example "org-restless-silence-28866559/28012f1d-fe85-4d69-be44-79f561ce10f6"
```
